Let  
\[
P_k=\prod_{i=1}^k \frac{3i-1}{3i}.
\]
Then the \(k\)-th term is
\[
\frac{\prod_{i=1}^k(3i-1)}{\prod_{i=1}^{k+1}3i}
=\frac{P_k}{3(k+1)}
=P_k-P_{k+1}.
\]
So the sum telescopes:
\[
S=\sum_{k=1}^{672}(P_k-P_{k+1})=P_1-P_{673}
=\frac23-P_{673}.
\]

Now bound \(P_{673}\). For \(i\ge 1\),
\[
\left(\frac{3i-1}{3i}\right)^3<\frac{i}{i+1},
\]
since
\[
27i^4-(3i-1)^3(i+1)=18i^2-8i+1>0.
\]
Thus
\[
P_{673}
<\prod_{i=1}^{673}\left(\frac{i}{i+1}\right)^{1/3}
=\left(\frac1{674}\right)^{1/3}
<\frac16.
\]

Also, for \(i\ge 2\),
\[
\left(\frac{3i}{3i-1}\right)^3<\frac{i}{i-1},
\]
so
\[
\frac1{P_{673}}
=\frac32\prod_{i=2}^{673}\frac{3i}{3i-1}
<\frac32\prod_{i=2}^{673}\left(\frac{i}{i-1}\right)^{1/3}
=\frac32\cdot 673^{1/3}
<15.
\]
Hence
\[
P_{673}>\frac1{15}.
\]

Therefore
\[
\frac12=\frac23-\frac16<S<\frac23-\frac1{15}=\frac35.
\]
So the decimal begins \(0.5\ldots\), and the first digit after the decimal point is

\[
\boxed{5}
\]
